error.artwork.notAnImage: SavePoint can use PNG, JPEG, and WebP pictures, and that file isn't a whole one of those. Choose a different picture.
error.artwork.tooLarge: That picture is bigger than {maxMegabytes} MB. Choose a smaller one.
error.capture.cancelled: Saving was canceled. Everything you saved earlier is untouched, so you can save again whenever you're ready.
error.capture.linkedFolder: A folder inside the game is a shortcut to another place on this computer, and SavePoint can't safely save or switch files through it. Replace the shortcut shown below with a real folder, or move it out of the game folder, then try again.
error.capture.nestedRepository: {count, plural, one {One of the game's folders keeps its own change history, which SavePoint can't save inside another.} other {# of the game's folders keep their own change history, which SavePoint can't save inside another.}} Move the hidden folder shown below out of the game folder, then try again.
error.catalog.corrupt: SavePoint couldn't read the file where it keeps your games and profiles, so it left the file exactly as it is. Restore the backup copy next to it (the same name ending in .bak) if there is one, or move the file away to start again with no games listed.
error.compaction.cancelled: Optimizing storage was canceled. Nothing was lost, and you can run it again any time.
error.compaction.preempted: Optimizing storage stopped so something else on this game could go first. Nothing was lost, and it runs again by itself after your next save.
error.consentMarker.conflict: That folder is already tracked by a different game in SavePoint.
error.consentMarker.missing: This folder has not been confirmed for SavePoint yet. Save again to confirm it.
error.diskSpace.low: There's not enough free disk space to save this profile right now.
error.game.notFound: That game isn't in your library anymore, so SavePoint couldn't do that. Go back to your games and try again.
error.gameService.gameRunning: {gameName} is running right now, so SavePoint can't do that yet. Close the game, then try again.
error.gameService.pathOverlap: That folder overlaps with {conflictingGameName}, which you already track. Pick a different location for one of them.
error.gameService.profileActive: This is the currently active profile. Switch to a different one before deleting it.
error.gameService.reconnectable: That folder has saved history from a game that's no longer in your library. Try adding it as a new game, or point it somewhere else.
error.git.unavailable: SavePoint can't run the built-in tool it uses to save and restore your files. Reinstall SavePoint to repair it, then open the app again.
error.gitOperation.amendNotAvailable: This profile can't be updated that way right now. Try creating a new profile instead.
error.gitOperation.checkoutFailed: Something else on your computer is holding one of the game's files open. Close the game, its launcher and any mod manager, then try again — SavePoint picks up where it left off and won't redo the work it already finished.
error.history.pointNotFound: That point isn't in this game's history anymore, so SavePoint couldn't go back to it. Open the history again and pick another one.
error.launch.detachedCaptureNotSupported: You're viewing an older save of this profile. Switch it back to the latest save before keeping new progress.
error.launch.dirtyWorkingTree: There are unsaved changes in the way - resolve them and try again.
error.launch.noActiveSession: SavePoint isn't tracking a play session for this game right now. Start the game from SavePoint to begin one.
error.launch.sessionMoved: The game's files changed outside this play session, so SavePoint can't safely keep your new progress here. Start the game again from SavePoint and play from the save you want to keep.
error.launch.sessionStillRunning: The game is still running. Close it, then try again.
error.launch.spawnFailed: SavePoint couldn't start the game. Check the launch settings in Edit game.
error.launch.switchInterrupted: The last switch didn't finish, so the {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} holds files from two saves. Switch again to finish it, or discard the changes to bring the folder back to a saved point.
error.launch.unavailable: Starting games isn't available in this build yet. Your saved history is safe.
error.launch.windowsProgram: This game starts through a Windows program, which SavePoint can't run directly on {os, select, macos {macOS} other {Linux}}. In Edit game, set how to start the game to Through Steam, or choose a program built for {os, select, macos {macOS} other {Linux}}.
error.operation.cancelled: That was canceled before it finished, so nothing changed.
error.path.missing: SavePoint still has everything it saved for this game, but it can't find the {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} anymore. Point it at the new location to carry on.
error.pathSafety.tier1Blocked: Pick the game's own folder rather than the whole drive or {os, select, windows {a Windows folder} macos {a macOS system folder} other {a system folder}} — SavePoint replaces everything inside whatever you point it at, so it won't work on a location this large.
error.pathSafety.tier2Blocked: Pick the game's own folder rather than the whole drive or {os, select, windows {a Windows folder} macos {a macOS system folder} other {a system folder}} — SavePoint replaces everything inside whatever you point it at, so it won't work on a location this large.
error.profile.alreadyExists: You already have a profile with that name. Pick a different name.
error.profile.noPoints: That profile has nothing saved yet, so there is nothing to switch to. Save something in it first.
error.profile.notFound: That profile doesn't exist anymore, so SavePoint couldn't do that. Go back to the game's profiles and try again.
error.storage.unreachable: SavePoint can't reach the folder where it keeps your saved history. If it's on a drive or network share that isn't connected, connect it, then try again.
error.storageRelocation.cancelled: Moving your storage was canceled. You can try again from Settings.
error.storageRelocation.copyFailed: SavePoint couldn't copy everything to the new folder, so it kept using the old one and nothing was lost. Check that the new location has room and isn't read-only, then try again.
error.storageRelocation.destinationNotEm: That folder already has files in it. Choose an empty folder for your storage.
error.validation.invalidPayload: Some of these fields aren't valid yet. Check the name and paths above.
